means: Reads the entry of the rdp table at the index. If it is absent, returns false. Otherwise, reads the entry of the conf table at the index (treating an absent entry as 0). Returns true if the rdp entry is greater than rdp_thresh and the conf entry is greater than or equal to conf_thresh.
name: confident_bypass

means: Calculates a target value as the sample multiplied by the scale, clamped to the table's maximum. Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is absent, sets it to the target value. If present, computes the signed difference (target - entry), divides it by 2 to the power of shift (integer division rounding towards zero), and adds the result to the entry. The final value is clamped to the table's minimum (0) and maximum.
name: train_ema

means: Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is absent, sets it to the table's maximum. If present, adds the penalty to the entry, clamping the result to the table's maximum.
name: train_penalty

means: Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is present, greater than the threshold, and the sample is less than or equal to the threshold, subtracts the penalty from the entry, clamping the result to 0. Otherwise, does nothing.
name: penalize_wrong_bypass

means: Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is present and strictly greater than the cap, sets it to the cap.
name: cap_value

means: Reads the entry of the rdp table at the index. If it is absent, returns false. Divides the rdp entry by div (integer division). If this value is not strictly greater than the absolute value of the victim key of the chosen way, returns false. Otherwise, reads the entry of the conf table at the index (treating an absent entry as 0). Returns true if the conf entry is greater than or equal to conf_thresh.
name: confident_table_exceeds_victim

means: Reads the entry of the rdp table at the index. If it is absent, returns false. Otherwise, reads the entry of the conf table at the index (treating an absent entry as 0). Returns true if the conf entry is greater than or equal to conf_thresh, and the rdp entry divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than the absolute value of the victim key of the way the victim search chose.
name: confident_exceeds_victim

means: Reads the entry of the rdp table at the index. If it is absent, returns false. Otherwise, reads the entry of the conf table at the index (treating an absent entry as 0). Returns true if the rdp entry is greater than rdp_thresh and the conf entry is greater than or equal to conf_thresh.

If the conf entry is less than conf_thresh, returns false. Otherwise, divides the rdp entry by div (integer division rounding down). Returns true if the quotient is greater than the absolute value of the victim key of the way chosen by the victim search.
name: safe_table_bypass

means: Reads the entry of the conf table at the index (treating an absent entry as 0). Returns true if the entry is greater than or equal to conf_thresh.
name: conf_check

means: Reads the entry of the rdp table at the index. If it is present and greater than rdp_thresh, sets the entry of the conf table at the index to 0 to heavily penalize the wrong bypass prediction. Otherwise, decrements the conf table entry by 1 (clamping at 0).
name: punish_wrong_bypass

means: Sets the entry of the table at the index to 0.
name: reset_table_entry

means: Reads the entry of the table at the index. If it is absent, sets it to the table's maximum. If present, computes the signed difference (table's maximum - entry), divides it by 2 to the power of shift (integer division rounding towards zero), and adds the result to the entry. The final value is clamped to the table's minimum (0) and maximum.
